# dilettante

> an amateur who engages in an activity without serious intentions and who pretends to have knowledge.

> Person who takes up an art or activity for amusement only or in a superficial way

> a person with an amateur interest in the arts or a particular field


## Example

- *Fred has no formal medical training; while he likes to claim authority on medical issues, he is little more than a dilettante.*
